new_operator: Gaussian Poisson after duality of the live rp^4 long operator. Four gcd types, raw same-colour deletion, primitive opposite-colour quadratic, CRT crossed product of two quadratic matrices. Squarefree-pair bound T+AB(A+B).
all_sixthfree_r: Freeze squarefull part u at small norm and compare true primitive conductors at large norm. Gives E^-1[L/P+RP(R+P)+(RL)^(2/3)]. At R,P~D^(1/4) and E=1, the joint bound costs D^(5/6) with epsilon.
mixed_v2: Take the minimum of actual small-d band estimates at fixed original k, gaining A2^-13/14 and paying positive Nk^-27/14. Finite signed k and masks are kept.
failure_scope: At pure R near D^(2/7), P near unit, the sharp individual row and L/P comparison meet without enough saving. Improving only the quadratic cross term cannot remove this term of the budget. No lower bound for the signed object.
